description: BUILD THE DRAFT into a self-contained HTML report — the same assembly qa_report_build does and the same one the panel’s Build button runs, so a document written by hand and one written here are the same document. It is KEPT in the extension by default, which is how the person finds it in the panel an hour later; `save: false` builds a preview and keeps nothing. THE DRAFT IS ONLY EMPTIED IF THE DOCUMENT WAS REALLY KEPT. When the browser has no room the HTML still comes back and the lines stay where they were — losing the work and the built document in the same breath is the one outcome this must never have. It refuses for the reasons qa_report_build refuses, and the important one is NO PICTURE: a page of assertions about an application showing none of them is the artefact this product exists to replace.

name.description: Keep it under this name, replacing a document of the same name rather than leaving a stale twin above it.

out.description: Write the HTML here as well. Without it the document comes back inline, which for a report with pictures in it is usually the wrong trade.

save.description: false builds it without keeping anything — a preview. Default is to keep it.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_draft_build
title: Turn the draft into the document
